title: `topics/argument-from-reason` quotes "space of causes" as Sellars's (the phrase is not in EPM), offers Goldman's relevant-alternatives theory as a reply to the generality problem (it is his 1976 account of perceptual knowledge), cites the SEP entry under the wrong title and without its co-author, and states the argument in its strong form in the lead while the body calls it "not a decisive disproof"
